proposal.lesson: Receipts show channel=2 for two puts on same key with committed_sum=2, ruling out ignore (would be 1) and total_both (would be 4). Rollback receipt channel=2 with committed_sum=1 shows counter is not net committed effects. Remaining ambiguity resolved by simulation over the disclosed family.

proposal.scope: Family: put mode (IGNORE/REPLACE/UPSERT), optional AFTER INSERT trigger, channel (changes/total_changes main/total_changes main+other). Simulate all 18 members against receipts, keep consistent ones, answer only if all agree.
proposal.lesson: Receipts show put twice on same key yields channel 2 and sum 2, so put is REPLACE or UPSERT with trigger or total_changes; rollback restores committed state but channel still counts attempted writes, so channel is total_changes-like, not changes().
